answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 389 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the sonnet challenge, the forge audit can replay the beacon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1271 identities would post 4470 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
